title: SQL injection via direct string interpolation of caller-supplied project parameter
detail: `region_for()` constructs a raw SQL string at line 11 using `% (TABLE, project)` — the `TABLE` constant is safe, but `project` is a function parameter supplied by the caller. A value such as `' OR '1'='1` or `'; DROP TABLE tenant_region_assignment; --` would be interpreted by the database engine as SQL. The string is passed verbatim to `cursor.execute()` at line 10 with no parameterisation. Callers and the origin of the `project` value are not visible in this file. Confirmed by bandit B608 (MEDIUM/MEDIUM).
